list:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <TransformInput expression="{parse: text => `Like('%${text}%')`, format: text => text ? text.replace(new RegExp(`.*%(.*)%.*`), '$1') : ''}" component="TextInput" source="title"/>,
 <ReferenceInput source="tags" reference="pageTagName">
  <TransformInput expression="{parse: text => `{name: '${text}'}`, format: text => text ? text.replace(new RegExp(`.*'(.*)'.*`), '$1') : ''}" component="SelectInput" source="tags"/>
 </ReferenceInput>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <FunctionField source="id" render={record =>
   <Transform expression="{to: `/${id}`}" component="Link" id={record.id}>
    {record.id}
   </Transform>
  }/>
  <TextField source="title"/>
  <ArrayField source="tags">
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <ChipField source="name" size="small"/>
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>
create:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <TextInput source="title"/>
   <TextInput multiline source="body" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Tags">
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <ReferenceInput source="name" reference="pageTagName">
      <SelectInput validate={[required()]}/>
     </ReferenceInput>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>
